notes.title: Small patch July 09, 2022
notes.content:
-Reworked buy pixels in fight
-Hatchery upgrade all buttons now show correct values
-Can now sell back metal and plastic after high market level
-Removed Firework Fish as casino reward
-Event date now says it goes through the 10th (will end at 12am on the 11th)

notes.title: Small Patch June 28, 2022
notes.content:
-Fight removed MIN damage upgrade, all damage will now always hit for max amount
-Fight added block upgrade. There is a 15% chance to block each attack, the block percent can be upgraded to 100% of damage blocked.
-Fixed game crash caused when the Market increases by a large amount of levels at once

notes.title: Small Patch June 23, 2022
notes.content:
-Changed how hatchery tank upgrade scaling works. There are now drastically less clicks needed to get a high capacity
-Can no longer sell more tokens than you have
-Slots now displays the correct payout for triple pixels and exp

notes.title: Adjustment
notes.content: Fixed Hatchery upgrade values being updated incorrectly

notes.title: Hatchery changes
notes.content:
Added buttons to buy max amount of upgrades in Hatchery
Hatchery can no longer be manually toggled on and off, button will now indicate status
Increased cost to upgrade Hatchery after a certain upgrade level
Buying max upgrades in fight will no longer freeze game at high numbers
Some balance and other misc changes

notes.title: Small patch
notes.content:
Decreased the amount of slot spins needed for achievement from 50k to 10k
Added option in settings to change resolution to 2560x1440. More resolutions are being tested.

*Auto-match appears to be crashing some games and can potentially corrupt a save file. If this happens, you will see a message explaining how to restore the save. I am very sorry for this issue, it is proving to be quite complicated to solve

notes.title: Casino fixes, possible UI fix
notes.content:
Match bet 100 will now correctly calculate the multiplier
Match will now properly choose a new random fish and gem after each round
Fixed crystals not always being awarded from slot wins
Added 1k and 10k options to token exchange
Bosses will now always drop their gem even if Dam and Sky fishing have been unlocked
UI will automatically reset on load if not in full screen

notes.title: Possible fix for shifted UI elements
notes.content: Added a button to settings to reset the UI. This is experimental and has not been confirmed to work in all instances.

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.content:
Fixed incubators 3 and 4 not calculating double chance properly
Fixed slots sometimes not spending the correct amount of tokens
Fixed sometimes obtaining both gems when killing one boss
Fixed Droplet and Sky Crystal tooltip and fight area

Progress is being made on auto-buy tokens for match, but it is still not ready to be re-enabled
